Sputum is mucoid, non blood stained , non foul smelling.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESeasonal variation-cough is more during nights\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eaggrevated on exposure to dust and cool air .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen she developed breathlessness from 7 days which is of grade-ll, gradual in onset, seasonal variation on exposure to dust and cool air.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWheeze- present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo orthopnea, no paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea , no cause of fever, chest tightness , palpitations,hemoptysis and sweating\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThroat pain ,burning micturition and History of allergy.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o\u0026nbsp; loss of weight or loss of appetite\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo similar complaints in the past\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnown case of Hypothyroidism since 5 months (Thyronorm 50mcg)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o Diabetes mellitus, Hypertension,Coronary artery disease , Epilepsy, Tuberculosis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite : Normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet: Mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements: Regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions : No\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMicturition: Burning micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnown Allergies : yes to dust and cool air\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot significant\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMenstrual History:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAge of menarche-12 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDuration-3 to 5 days , normal flow for every 28days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneral Examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient is conscious, coherent and cooperative and well oriented to time, place and person\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EModerately built and well nourished\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo pallor, icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, lymphadenopathy and Edema\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemperature: Afebrile\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPulse rate: 95\/min\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERespiratory rate: 22\/min\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP: 120\/80mm \/Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpo2 at room air 97%\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGRBS:132mg%\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESystemic examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUpper respiratory tract examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELeft sided deviated nasal septum\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOral cavity- normal oral hygiene\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELower respiratory tract :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInspection :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- shape of chest is symmetrical,elliptical\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Chest expansion equal on both sides\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPalpation :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAll inspectory findings are confirmed with palpation.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Trachea central in position.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; Apex beat felt at Left 5th intercoastal space, 1 inch median to mid clavicular line\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No local rise in temperature\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No tenderness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Chest movements: Equal on both sides\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAuscultation:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBilateral air entry This E log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\"I've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 50 year old female patient came to hospital with the complaint of chest pain since 2 days ,burning micturition since 9 months and has tingling sensation in both upper and lower limbs since 1 year. Neck pain,\u0026nbsp; headache since the last 1 year and backache, knee pain since 1 year.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS: Patient is apparently asymptomatic 2 days back then had chest pain ( pricking type) on walking. She has burning micturition since 12 months and tingling sensation in both upper and lower limbs. Neck pain, knee pain since 1 year and has decreased appetite since 7 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o HTN\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o DM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o TB\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o epilepsy\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o\u0026nbsp;
